description:
Upgrade your Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra Crew Cab with OEDRO Running Boards, designed for both rugged durability and sleek style. Featuring a drop-down side step design, these nerf bars make getting in and out of your truck easier and safer. Built with a heavy-duty square tube structure and finished with dual-stage textured black powder coating, they offer excellent rust and corrosion resistance while adding aggressive, off-road-ready looks. With a quick, no-drill installation, OEDRO step rails deliver the perfect blend of functionality, protection, and bold appearance for your truck.
Features
Perfect Fitment: Custom-designed for Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra Crew Cab, ensuring a sleek, factory-style appearance.
Heavy-Duty Strength: Built from carbon steel with a reinforced square tube structure, each side supports up to 450 lbs.
Safe & Comfortable Access : 4.7-inch drop step with a 4-inch wide, non-slip surface for easier and safer entry in all conditions.
Corrosion & Weather Resistant : Dual-stage e-coating protects against rust, corrosion, and harsh weather environments.
Quick Bolt-On Installation: No drilling required; includes all mounting hardware for a fast, DIY installation.
1-Year Warranty & Professional Installation is highly Recommended.

Compatible with 2019-2026 Chevy Silverado 1500 Crew Cab.

highlights: Rugged Drop-Step Design for a Bold Truck Look: Featuring a drop-down side step design with a reinforced square tube structure, these running boards add an aggressive off-road style while complementing the rugged appearance of Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks. The wide step profile provides a factory-style upgrade with enhanced visual impact.

Heavy-Duty Steel Construction Built to Last: Made from durable carbon steel and protected with a dual-stage e-coating finish, these nerf bars offer excellent resistance against rust, corrosion, and harsh weather conditions. The reinforced structure supports up to 450 lbs per side, delivering dependable strength for daily driving and off-road use.

Easier Access with Enhanced Safety: The 4.7-inch drop step design lowers the stepping height for more comfortable entry and exit, especially for lifted trucks. The 4-inch wide anti-slip stepping surface provides secure footing in rain, mud, and other challenging conditions, making every step safer and more convenient.
